name: Kashima Neo
source: A patron of "YuKuRu" and an old acquaintance of [url=/c66131]Inaho Shin[/url]. She works as a freelance journalist, writing about all sorts of things, but mainly about fashion and towns. She's even been putting out articles about pro-wrestling recently, but she isn't exactly thrilled about it. As a result, she's been questioning her direction in life. She's protective of her younger sister [url=/c7876]Mifu[/url]. [url=/c66136]Kanami [/url] is her colleague through profession.
